_comment: Authors linked to a narrator-database person by hand, for the cases the automatic name+death check cannot decide (the person has no death year in Noor, or a wrong one, or a title like «السيد» in the name). Key: an OpenITI author id (applies to every spelling of that author the catalogues use) or "<author as catalogued>|<death year>". Every entry says in `note` what was checked; build/authors.py ignores an entry without a note or with an id that does not exist.

openiti:0460ShaykhTusi.note: Noor 5102 is exactly «محمد بن الحسن بن علي الطوسي»; its only death year (525, from a KG link) is wrong, al-Tusi died 460

طوسی، محمد بن حسن|460.note: same person as openiti:0460ShaykhTusi, catalogued in Persian form

openiti:0436SharifMurtada.note: Noor 3997 «علي بن الحسين السيد المرتضى», death 436 in Noor and in al-Tusi's Fihrist; the title «السيد» is dropped before comparing, so «الشريف المرتضى» did not match

openiti:0406SharifRadi.note: Noor 5113 «محمد بن الحسين السيد الرضي», death 406 in Noor

ابن‌بابویه، محمد بن علی|381.note: Noor 5507 «محمد بن علي بن الحسين بن بابويه»: death 381 in al-Najashi and WikiShia (Noor's own 331 is the odd one out); the words «محمد بن علي» are too common for the automatic rule

openiti:0573IbnHibatAllahQutbDinRawandi.note: Noor 2744 «سعيد بن هبة الله الراوندي» is Qutb al-Din al-Rawandi (d. 573); Noor has no death year for him

طبرسی، فضل بن حسن|548.note: Noor 1517 «الفضل بن الحسن الطبرسي»; its death year (523, from a KG link) is wrong, al-Tabrisi died 548

openiti:0664IbnTawus.note: Noor 4234 «علي بن موسى بن جعفر بن طاوس» (Sayyid Ibn Tawus, d. 664); no death year in Noor

openiti:0449AbuFathKarajiki.note: Noor 5527 «محمد بن علي بن عثمان الكراجكي» (d. 449); no death year in Noor

openiti:0363QadiNucman.note: Noor 35374 «النعمان بن محمد ابن حيون التميمي المغربي», OpenITI gives «النعمان بن محمد بن منصور بن حيون», d. 363

openiti:0450Najashi.note: Noor 563 «أحمد بن علي بن أحمد بن العباس النجاشي»; OpenITI gives «أحمد بن علي بن أحمد بن عباس الأسدي الكوفي», d. 450

علامه حلی، حسن بن یوسف|726.note: Noor 1231 «الحسن بن يوسف بن المطهر العلامة الحلي» (d. 726)

openiti:0726CallamaHilli.note: Noor 1231 «الحسن بن يوسف بن المطهر العلامة الحلي» (d. 726); OpenITI's own full name for this id is garbled but its short name is «العلامة الحلي»

openiti:0381IbnBabawayhSaduq.note: Noor 5507 «محمد بن علي بن الحسين بن بابويه» is al-Saduq: death 381 in al-Najashi and WikiShia; OpenITI spells a grandfather «موسا», so the lineages do not line up
